r3_note: The engine writes عم as أم (dropped ع, S4) in every uncle/cousin line (أمي = عمي, أمتي = عمتي). Plural rules: invented broken plurals are vocab tier 2 per READER-BRIEF (D3, D7, D8, D17); singular/plural mix-ups and a count needing a plural are grammar (D9 E1, D12 A9). At D4 Amal first stated a number-order rule, then withdrew it herself (واحد مهندس = 'one is an engineer'), so only the gender slip is kept.

rows.medi_said: Is it مي- uh, مئين؟ مئين؟ مئين؟
rows.amal_said: No. ميا. Let's go to ميا first. Is ميا feminine؟ ... So what do we do to dual form؟

He used على for 'above' (he then asked 'is above على?'); Amal said لا and he reached فوق راسي at 23:31. Sheet: up / above | Foaq | فوق. A different lexical item, not a preposition-choice rule.

rows.medi_said: Is it محرك or just حركة؟
rows.why: He asked between محرك (motor) and حركة for 'movement'; Amal picked حركة.
حركة is feminine so the number-adjective must be واحدة; Amal recast it.

rows.amal_said: بعد. What do we put after بعد؟ ... ما.
rows.why: After بعد the verb needs ما and drops the b-; Amal prompted and he said ما أحمل.

rows.medi_said: I put it past tense. أنا بطيت أريحا. Is that right? بطيت أريحا. No?
rows.why: For 'I put it back' he used a put/stop verb (engine بطيت; أريحا is an engine artifact, treated as a name); Amal said No and gave the رجع verb.

He gave the verb 'I work' for the noun 'jobs'; Amal said No and asked for the plural of شغل.
Wrong plural pattern for شغل; Amal said No and accepted أشغال.

rows.medi_said: أنااا بشتغل معاا أبوي في المحل السجاد.
rows.why: In idafa the first word never takes el-; Amal recast في محل السجاد.
rows.english: I work with my dad in the carpet shop.

rows.medi_said: أخوي آآ مح-- أخوي محمد، or محمد؟
rows.amal_said: محامي. It's long and it's not doubled.

rows.why: مهندس is masculine so واحد; Amal recast twice.

rows.why: 'The other one' needs el-; Amal prompted with 'the' and he said التاني.

rows.medi_said: أستاذ مهندس. أستاذ مهندس؟ Or مهندس الأستاذ؟ No، أستاذ مهندس.

rows.amal_said: Where do I put the ل؟ Actually we never put ل. آخر واحد.
rows.why: 'The last one' takes no el- after آخر; Amal said we never put ل and gave آخر واحد.

rows.amal_said: Actually we never put ل. آخر واحد.

Invented plural of عم (also أماو at 38:15; engine writes عم as أم, a dropped ع); Amal recast أعمامي.

rows.medi_said: Okay. And then would I say أماو، أم ماو؟ What was the plural for أم، أم مو؟

rows.medi_said: ابن أمي، أم، أم مو، أم.

rows.medi_said: لا، بس الـ، الـ ولاد أمي عندهم ولاد.
